state_definitions.INITIALIZING: Service started, loading config and DB pool, traffic blocked
state_definitions.CHECKING_DEPENDENCIES: Actively evaluating postgres, redis, storage, workers, ai
state_definitions.READY: All critical and required capabilities healthy, traffic fully admitted
state_definitions.DEGRADED: Optional dependency unavailable (e.g. Gemini AI), fallback mode active
state_definitions.NOT_READY: Critical dependency down (e.g. postgres), traffic withheld
state_definitions.RECOVERING: Dependencies returned, system validating warm pool stability
